description: This file implements the DefaultWebsocketConfig class, which provides a default implementation for WebsocketConfig. It reads configuration values related to websocket backpressure and throttling from a given ScopedConfig or Config object, and exposes these via getter methods. It also overrides equals, hashCode, and toString for object comparison and representation.

classes.name: DefaultWebsocketConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing WebsocketConfig, providing configuration settings for websocket backpressure and throttling based on external config input.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultWebsocketConfig instance from a Config object, applying fallback logic and configuration values.

methods.name: getSubscriberBackpressureQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the subscriber backpressure queue.

methods.name: getPublisherBackpressureBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of the publisher backpressure buffer.

methods.name: getThrottlingRejectionFactor
methods.description: Returns the throttling rejection factor configured for the websocket.

methods.name: getThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the ThrottlingConfig object associated with this websocket configuration.
